clips.title: The story
paras: At the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, William Pestle seeks candles from kobolds that have overstocked Elwynn Forest's mines. Visiting from his shop in Stormwind, the alchemist needs their thick wax, and the errand introduces adventurers to the subterranean pests encroaching on the kingdom's valuable gold veins.

William Pestle runs Pestle's Apothecary with his brother in Stormwind City's Trade District. Wax is always in short supply as he brews remedies, ointments, and concoctions. Instead of buying polished candles from city merchants, Pestle turns to the vermin in Elwynn. The kobolds carry hefty lumps of tallow and wax on their brows, ready for an adventurer willing to pry them loose.

Kobolds have overrun Fargodeep Mine south of Goldshire and Jasperlode Mine to the northeast. These snuffling creatures prize their candles above almost all else. The flickering flames guide them through dark shafts as they dig for gold and shiny trinkets. Taking the candles replenishes Pestle's alchemy stocks and chips away at the vermin choking off the kingdom's precious mining claims.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, good sir! Do you have a moment?
My brother and I run an apothecary in Stormwind, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax. Can you help me?

You can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines... The Fargodeep mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east. I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you gather those candles yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You were busy hunting kobolds, were you? Thanks for the candles, friend, and here's your reward...
